t: In Thai, what is the meaning of 'kob kun ka'? - Quora
s: Answer (1 of 32): Kob kun ka means thank you sir. Please note we have a special way of politely ending what we say in Thai language by the word “kub" and “Ka". Kub is used when the speaker is a man.
